# rights type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:rightsType`](gmeow-rightsType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/rightsType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

The kind(s) of intellectual-property right a statement concerns — one of the open [`gmeow:RightsType`](../classes/gmeow-RightsType.md) values (copyright, trademark, patent, industrial design, trade secret, related rights, moral rights, database right, plant breeders' rights). Non-functional: a statement may span several.
